title: La semaine
en: Days of the week & times of day
intro: The days of the week, the parts of the day, and words to put things in order. Days and months are **masculine** and take **no capital letter** in French: *lundi, mardi…*

words.def: Le premier jour de la semaine.
words.def_en: The first day of the week.

examples.en: On Monday, I'm starting a new job.
On Mondays, I go to the market.

words.note: **lundi** = on (this) Monday. **le lundi** = on Mondays (every Monday).

words.def: Le jour après lundi.
words.def_en: The day after Monday.

examples.en: On Tuesday, I have a French class.
On Tuesdays, the museum is closed.

words.def: Le jour au milieu de la semaine, après mardi.
words.def_en: The day in the middle of the week, after Tuesday.

examples.fr: Le **mercredi**, les enfants n'ont pas école.
examples.en: On Wednesdays, children don't have school.

words.note: In France, many young children don't go to school on Wednesday.

words.def: Le jour après mercredi.
words.def_en: The day after Wednesday.

examples.en: On Thursday, I'm having dinner at my sister's.

examples.fr: Le **jeudi**, il y a un marché.

words.def: Le dernier jour de travail de la semaine.
words.def_en: The last working day of the week.

examples.en: On Friday evening, we're going to the cinema.

words.def: Le premier jour du week-end.
words.def_en: The first day of the weekend.

examples.en: On Saturday, I'm doing the shopping.

words.def: Le dernier jour de la semaine. Beaucoup de magasins sont fermés.
words.def_en: The last day of the week. Many shops are closed.

examples.fr: Le **dimanche**, toute la famille déjeune ensemble.
examples.en: On Sundays, the whole family has lunch together.
On Sunday, we're going to my grandparents'.

words.def: Sept jours, de lundi à dimanche.
words.def_en: Seven days, from Monday to Sunday.

examples.en: I work five days a week.

examples.fr: La **semaine** prochaine, je pars à Paris.
examples.en: Next week, I'm going to Paris.

words.def: Samedi et dimanche : beaucoup de gens ne travaillent pas.
words.def_en: Saturday and Sunday: many people don't work.

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?

words.def: Vingt-quatre heures. Une semaine a sept jours.
words.def_en: Twenty-four hours. A week has seven days.

examples.fr: Il y a sept **jours** dans une semaine.
examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
It's my first day at work.

words.note: **le jour** = the day as a unit (count them). **la journée** = the day as a length of time (what you do in it).

words.def: Le temps du matin au soir.
words.def_en: The time from morning to evening.

words.def: Le début de la journée, avant midi.
words.def_en: The start of the day, before noon.

examples.en: In the morning, I drink a coffee.

examples.fr: Je pars à six heures du **matin**.
examples.en: I leave at six in the morning.

words.def: Le temps entre midi et le soir.
words.def_en: The time between noon and the evening.

examples.en: This afternoon, I'm going to the park.

examples.fr: Il est trois heures de l'**après-midi**.

words.def: La fin de la journée, avant la nuit.
words.def_en: The end of the day, before the night.

examples.en: In the evening, I watch TV.

words.def: Quand il fait noir et qu'on dort.
words.def_en: When it's dark and people sleep.

examples.en: I sleep eight hours a night.

words.def: Le jour avant aujourd'hui.
words.def_en: The day before today.

examples.fr: **Hier** soir, c'était la fête de Sophie.

words.note: **c'était** = it was (you'll learn the past tenses later).

words.def: Le jour après aujourd'hui.
words.def_en: The day after today.

words.def: Avant l'heure normale : se lever tôt.
words.def_en: Before the usual time: to get up early.

words.def: Après l'heure normale : se coucher tard.
words.def_en: After the usual time: to go to bed late.
words.note: **tard** = late in the day. For being late for something, say **en retard**.

words.def: En premier : d'abord ça, ensuite autre chose.
words.def_en: In first place: this first, then something else.

words.def: Après ça, en deuxième.
words.def_en: After that, second.

examples.fr: D'abord je me lève, **ensuite** je m'habille.
examples.en: First I get up, then I get dressed.

examples.fr: On mange, et **ensuite** on va au cinéma.
examples.en: We'll eat, and then we'll go to the cinema.

words.def: À la fin, en dernier.
words.def_en: At the end, last of all.

story.title: La semaine de Hugo
story.en: Hugo's first week at his new job.

lines.fr: Hugo a un nouveau travail ! Il travaille dans un bureau, du lundi au vendredi.
lines.en: Hugo has a new job! He works in an office, Monday to Friday.

lines.fr: Lundi, c'est mon premier jour. Je me lève très tôt : à six heures !
lines.en: Monday is my first day. I get up very early: at six!

lines.fr: Le matin, il prend le bus. L'après-midi, il a des réunions.
lines.en: In the morning, he takes the bus. In the afternoon, he has meetings.

lines.fr: Mardi et mercredi, je travaille tard. Je rentre à neuf heures du soir.
lines.en: On Tuesday and Wednesday, I work late. I get home at nine in the evening.

lines.fr: Jeudi, il est très fatigué. La journée est longue !
lines.en: On Thursday, he's very tired. The day is long!

lines.fr: Hugo, tu viens dîner chez nous demain ?
lines.en: Hugo, are you coming to dinner at our place tomorrow?

lines.fr: Demain ? Euh… quel jour on est ?
lines.en: Tomorrow? Um… what day is it?

lines.fr: Hier, c'était mercredi. Aujourd'hui, c'est jeudi. Demain, c'est vendredi !
lines.en: Yesterday was Wednesday. Today is Thursday. Tomorrow is Friday!

lines.fr: Vendredi soir, Hugo dîne chez Léa et Sophie.
lines.en: On Friday evening, Hugo has dinner at Léa and Sophie's.
So, how was your first week?

lines.fr: D'abord, je suis fatigué. Ensuite, j'ai faim. Et enfin… c'est le week-end !
lines.en: First, I'm tired. Next, I'm hungry. And finally… it's the weekend!

lines.fr: Qu'est-ce que tu fais samedi et dimanche ?
lines.en: What are you doing on Saturday and Sunday?

lines.fr: Samedi, je dors ! Dimanche… je dors aussi.
lines.en: On Saturday, I sleep! On Sunday… I sleep too.

lines.fr: La nuit ? Je dors, bien sûr !
lines.en: At night? I sleep, of course!
